name: Fire Nation Cadets — no Lesson card in your graveyard: no firebending
notes: "This creature has firebending 2 as long as there's a Lesson card in your graveyard." was granted unconditionally (the condition was not readable). The graveyard card-count condition ("there are N or more X cards in your graveyard") now also reads "there is a/an X card in …" as one or more, checked against the graveyard zone. Here the graveyard holds a non-Lesson card and the opponent's graveyard holds a Lesson, so the Cadets have no firebending.
